per_view.notes: Slender gray tube with blunt nose and flat tail. Front-mounted partial hump with specks present. Wing reads only as a thin dark edge-on sliver. Tail is a wire-thin diagonal line, no fin surface or tailplane. Two box nacelles under mid-body, no clear pylons. Nose wheel plus clustered main wheels. Flat all-gray finish.

Slender gray tube with front hump bearing upper-deck windows and cockpit shading; main-deck window row present. Only two boxy nacelles visible below a thin flat swept wing slab. Tail is a blunt flat cut: no vertical fin, just a hairline antenna and a thin horizontal sliver. Wheels dangle on thin struts; one ball-tipped nose strut.

Slender tube fuselage with dotted window lines and a partial-length front hump capsule with cockpit shading. Wings render only as thin swept lines with no planform area; four dark nacelles appear to float off these lines without pylons. Tail surfaces are degenerate lines; a thin rod protrudes past the blunt tail. Uniform flat grey scheme.

Plain grey tube with flat blunt ends, no nose taper and no hump. Wings are thin stick-like rods, not surfaces; one nacelle floats above the fuselage on a strut, two cylinders hang near the right rods. Tail is bent wire segments. Two tiny black wheel blobs float below. Even window row is the strongest feature.

Slender gray tube with window dots and a front hump with upper-deck windows. Wings are paper-thin swept sticks with no chord or thickness; four cylinder nacelles hover near them, two clearly detached from any pylon. Tail shows only thin lines, no tall fin. Rear fuselage ends in a flat blunt disc. Small wheel clusters under mid-body.

Slender grey tube with flat blunt nose and tail caps. Partial front hump present as a crude block. Wings are thin paper-flat swept slabs, no taper; only two or three cylinder nacelles clearly visible. Tail is a stray diagonal stick plus tiny slab. Nose strut and two wheel clusters visible. Even oversized window dashes; monochrome grey.

Slender tube but nose ends in a flat blunt disk with an odd dark half-cylinder, no ogive taper. Partial-length hump with upper-deck windows present but reads as an unfaired capsule. Wings are thin flat swept boards, no taper; nacelles thin-pylon/near-floating, three visible. Tiny floating wheel clusters. Uniform flat gray, no livery accents.

critic.fix_suggestion: Improve 'Empennage (tall vertical stabilizer + horizontal stabilizers)' (mean 2.71/10). Target the 8 anchor: single tall swept vertical stabilizer plus swept horizontal stabilizers at the tail cone, plausible sizes; then the 10 anchor: correct 747 empennage: very tall swept fin, low-mounted swept tailplane pair with dihedral, all tapered and proportioned to the fuselage.
